A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same GRPO/λ-GRPO study. Their text, equations, tables, figures, and complete appendices support reliable comparison despite substantial reformatting.

before.justification: Sections 3.2 and 5 report original measurements of GRPO training structures and experiments comparing λ-GRPO with standard GRPO on reasoning benchmarks.

after.justification: Sections 3.2 and 5 retain the original training-structure measurements and Qwen/Llama reasoning-benchmark results.

M1.justification: λ-GRPO still scales each token's loss by the inverse size of its process set. v1 Equation 8 and v3 Equation 9 describe the same procedure; the expanded explanation does not introduce a new component.

E1.justification: Both versions use OpenRS for training and validation and evaluate on AIME24, MATH-500, AMC23, Minerva, and OlympiadBench. No dataset, domain, or evaluation scenario is added or removed.

E2.justification: Table 1 retains the same base Qwen/Llama models and standard-GRPO comparators under both KL-coefficient settings. Newly cited methods in v3 are not evaluated as additional baselines.

E3.justification: Sections 3.2 and 5.1 retain the same model sizes, training budgets, group sizes, learning rates, generation settings, 125-example validation split, metrics, and peak-validation checkpoint selection. The rewritten descriptions do not establish a changed evaluation protocol.

E4.justification: The group-size-6/36 analysis of path depth and intermediate proportion is retained. The same tree examples from steps 1, 1001, and 1673 move from Appendix C to Appendix E. The new overview schematic supplies explanation, not an additional empirical analysis.

E5.justification: Table 1 retains the same subscripted intervals and confidence-interval description. Neither version adds seed information, repeated-run counts, significance testing, or an uncertainty-estimation procedure.

E6.justification: All numerical entries in Tables 1 and 2 and the empirical plot contents match. Both report 12 of 6,700 trivial trees at group size 6, zero of 1,100 at group size 36, and λ-GRPO outperforming standard GRPO in 15 of 20 downstream comparisons.

T1.justification: v3 Equation 2c includes the KL coefficient β, omitted from v1's mathematical definition despite its experimental use. The equivalence theorem and DAPO/μ=1 assumptions remain unchanged. Lemma 1 and its Appendix B proof repackage the argument already present in v1 Equation 5.

C1.justification: The introduction softens its general frequency claim from the identical-prefix condition being 'almost always' met to 'often' met. The central objective-equivalence, λ-GRPO performance, and approximately twofold training-speedup claims are retained.

C2.justification: v3 removes v1's reversed-sign summary of the exploration/exploitation effects, retaining the consistent mechanism explanation. Appendix A now explicitly says λ-GRPO fully remedies the anti-exploration effect while only lessening anti-exploitation; v1 stated only the latter limitation. The small-model and single-training-dataset limitations remain.

D1.justification: The hardware, gradient accumulation, generation batch size, validation frequency, boxed-answer stopping rule, and hyperparameters are retained. The same GitHub code-access information moves from the reproducibility statement to the introduction; experimental details move from Appendix B to C.

R1.justification: v3 adds Ji et al. (2025) on tree-search reinforcement learning and Rafailov et al. (2024), From r to Q*. A new related-work paragraph distinguishes DPO's token-level reward representation from GRPO's Monte Carlo process rewards. The broader positioning remains intact.

P1.justification: The abstract, introduction, theoretical exposition, and related work are extensively rewritten. The theory gains named stages and expanded worked examples, Section 4 is divided into problem and method subsections, and an existing proof segment becomes an appendix lemma proof. These changes substantially reorganize the narrative.

P2.justification: v3 changes the main text from one column to two, adds a four-panel overview Figure 1, and redraws the original toy tree example with explicit letter tokens. Tables, plots, and appendix examples are resized or relocated throughout, while their empirical contents remain unchanged.

improvement.justification: The new overview figure, expanded token examples, reorganized proof, and additional research connections make the central argument easier to follow. Restoring β and removing the contradictory sign summary improve precision. These are useful but limited gains: the empirical support and the small-model, single-training-dataset limitations remain unchanged.
